description:

Awards & Recognition : Won NetApp Excellerator's\ "Best Growth Strategy Award,\" CloudSEK XVigil joined NVIDIA Inception Program, and won the NASSCOM Emerge 50 Cybersecurity Award. 2025 : Secured $19 million in funding led by Tenacity Ventures, Commvault.Role Overview: As a Customer Success Manager at CloudSEK, you will be the primary point of contact for a few strategic accounts, ensuring they derive maximum value from our cybersecurity solutions. Conduct configuration reviews and provide recommendations for product enhancements. Gather and analyze customer feedback to contribute to product development and improvement. VI. Operational Excellence: Maintain accurate records of customer interactions and activities in CRM systems. Contribute to the team by sharing knowledge, conducting training sessions, and writing internal articles.What we're looking for: 4-5 years of experience in Cybersecurity, Client-facing experience, or a related role in the cybersecurity industry. Strong understanding of cybersecurity principles, threat intelligence, and digital risk management. Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to build strong relationships with clients. Proven track record of achieving customer success goals and driving revenue growth. Ability to work independently and manage multiple accounts simultaneously.Cookie points if you have experience in the below skills: Business reviews Onsite meetings Maintaining NRR and GRR Threat analysis and Value deliveryBenefits of Joining CloudSEK We provide an environment where you can develop and enhance your skills while delivering meaningful work that matters. Food, unlimited snacks and drinks are all available while at office. And, the finest part is yet to come! Every now and then we ensure to unwind and have a good time together, which involves games, fun, and soulful music. Feel free to show off your artistic side here!CloudSEK is an equal opportunity employer and is committed to building a diverse and inclusive workplace. We encourage candidates from all backgrounds to apply.

description: Role Overview We are seeking a highly skilled Emerging Markets FX Trader with deep expertise in African and/or Latin American currencies to join our global trading & liquidity team. The ideal candidate will have extensive experience managing illiquid and restricted FX markets, executing OTC and interbank trades, and designing robust hedging and liquidity frameworks to support high-volume cross-border payment flows. Source and maintaindeep liquidity relationships with banks, brokers, and OTC desksacross relevant regions. Optimize hedging efficiency acrossmultiple liquidity venues including banks, ECNs, OTC desks, and crypto liquidity poolswhere relevant. Develop models fordynamic hedging, inventory risk management, and spread optimization. Monitor risk limits, PnL, and exposure across currency books.Trading Infrastructure & Systems Work closely with engineering and product teams to build and enhanceFX trading and hedging infrastructure, including: Automatedhedging engines Liquidity aggregation systems Smart order routing Pricing and risk management tools Integrate connectivity withbanks, ECNs, and liquidity providersvia APIs or FIX protocols. Improveexecution automation, latency optimization, and real-time exposure monitoring .Market Development Identify and onboardnew liquidity providers and OTC trading partnersacross emerging markets. Build pricing frameworks forilliquid currency pairsand support new corridor launches. Contribute to the development ofscalable FX infrastructuresupporting global payments and settlement flows.Requirements Experience 5–10+ years of FX trading experiencein Emerging Markets. Strong experience tradingAfrican or LATAM currencies, such as: Africa: NGN, KES, ZAR, GHS, EGP LATAM: BRL, MXN, COP, CLP, ARS Experience working at: Global banks EM FX trading firms Payment / fintech companies Crypto exchanges or market makers Proven experience executingOTC and institutional-sized FX trades .Technical Expertise Deep understanding of: FX market microstructure in illiquid markets NDF markets and offshore hedging Capital controls and FX regulatory frameworks Hands-on experience building or optimizing: FX trading systems Hedging engines Liquidity aggregation platforms Familiarity withFIX connectivity, API-based trading systems, and algorithmic execution .Skills Strong quantitative and analytical capabilities. Ability to operate inhigh-volatility and fragmented liquidity environments. Strong network withinEM FX liquidity providers and OTC trading desks. Excellent communication and cross-functional collaboration skills.Preferred Qualifications Experience supportinghigh-volume cross-border payment flows or treasury operations. Experience tradingEM FX through both traditional banks and alternative liquidity sources. Familiarity withstablecoin / crypto liquidity markets in emerging economies. Background inbuilding or scaling FX market-making operations. Strong analytical and problem solving skills Ability to operate across global teams and fast paced environmentsVision & Mission OSL is the first SFC-licensed digital asset platform in Hong Kong and a PayFi innovator. Through stablecoin payments, cross-border settlement and global licensing, we are building the next-generation payments network. Stablecoins have become everyday money across emerging markets and are widely viewed as blockchain's "killer app," with industry focus shifting from token issuance to real-world consumer and enterprise payment adoption. The strongest growth lies in cross-border B2B payments, where providers embedding stablecoins into corporate settlement flows can capture significant volume and float. Long-term defensibility comes from regulatory licences, banking partners and cross-border corridors. OSL holds or has acquired licences in Hong Kong, Japan, Australia, Bermuda and Indonesia, and is expanding into Europe, Brazil, Southeast Asia and Africa through acquisitions and licence applications. With OSL Pay and StableX, we embed stablecoin settlement into bank accounts and card networks, support 150+ digital assets, and provide 24/7 fiat–stablecoin conversion. As a regulated pioneer with a startup mindset, we believe the future of payments will be driven by real adoption and scalable deployment, not technology narratives. We welcome builders who are passionate about crypto and payments to join us in shaping compliant, global payment infrastructure.

title: Senior Salesforce Developer
description:
Senior Salesforce Developer BrazilImportant Information Location:Brazil Job Mode:Full-time Work Mode:Work from homeJob Summary We are seeking an experienced Senior Salesforce Developer with Data Cloud experience to support a strategic initiative focused on reducing customer churn by integrating and enriching customer data across multiple platforms. This role will work closely with the Salesforce Architect, data engineering teams, and cross-functional partners to ingest, unify, and expose data within Salesforce CRM and Salesforce Data 360 (Data Cloud).Responsibilities and Duties Lead end-to-end ingestion and mapping of customer data from Salesforce CRM, Siebel, Azure/Microsoft Fabric, Oracle, and churn model outputs into Salesforce Data 360;
Design, build, and maintain identity and account unification rules to produce accurate customer matching and golden records;
Create scalable, repeatable pipelines for ingestion, transformation, mapping, and controlled promotion across environments (including Data 360 data kits);
Enrich Salesforce CRM records with Data 360 attributes and analytics/model insights (e.G., churn) using related lists, dynamic related lists, and custom UI components;
Support CRM data strategy during the Siebel-to-Salesforce migration, prioritizing Salesforce CRM as the system of engagement as adoption increases;
Develop and support APIs and integration services for secure internal consumption of Data 360 and CRM data;
partner with architecture/engineering on integration patterns and implement ETL when native connectors don't meet requirements;
Monitor and optimize Data 360 credit consumption to balance cost, performance, and SLAs;
Enable business teams to use enriched customer data for segmentation, activation, and analytics use cases;
Document processes, standards, and runbooks;
contribute to shared enablement resources to drive adoption and operational continuity.Essential Skills Experience with Salesforce development;
Strong proficiency in: Apex, SOQL/SOSL, Lightning Web Components (LWC), Salesforce core data model, Salesforce APIs (REST/SOAP/Bulk), and integration design patterns;
Hands-on experience with Data ingestion and harmonization, Identity resolution and unification rules, Data kits and environment promotion, Large-scale data processing;
Experience connecting Salesforce Data Cloud/Data 360 to external systems (Azure/Microsoft Fabric, Oracle, Siebel, or similar), including when to use native connectors vs. custom integrations;
Experience with ETL processes and/or tools (e.G., Informatica, MuleSoft, Talend, Databricks);
Experience working in Agile/Scrum teams;
Strong technical communication skills, able to translate complex concepts for architects, engineers, business users, and leadership;
Advanced English to be in contact with customer representative on a daily basis.Highly Desirable Skills Experience with Salesforce Marketing Cloud, especially data activation and segmentation;
Experience with Siebel CRM integration and/or data migration;
Knowledge of telecom customer data, churn analytics, or Customer 360 implementations;
Familiarity with Azure data engineering and Microsoft Fabric connector limitations;
Understanding of scalable deployment pipelines and DevOps tooling (Git, CI/CD).About EncoraEncora is the preferred digital engineering and modernization partner of some of the world's leading enterprises and digital native companies. With over 9,000 experts in 47+ offices and innovation labs worldwide, Encora's technology practices include Product Engineering & Development, Cloud Services, Quality Engineering, DevSecOps, Data & Analytics, Digital Experience, Cybersecurity, and AI & LLM Engineering.At Encora, we hire professionals based solely on their skills and qualifications, and do not discriminate based on age, disability, religion, gender, sexual orientation, socioeconomic status, or nationality.

title: Médico Endocrinologista

Nossa missão é tornar o cuidado de saúde acessível a todos, em qualquer lugar e a qualquer momento. DESCRIÇÃO DAS ATIVIDADES:Fornecer atendimento médico especializado emEndocrinologiade forma remota, através de consultas e avaliações realizadas por meio de plataformas digitais de comunicação.Experiência e conhecimento para o diagnóstico, tratamento e acompanhamento de pacientes com doenças e distúrbiosEndocrinológicos .Realizar consultas em Telemedicina sendo capaz de conduzir anamnese virtual para coletar queixas e histórico médico, realizar exame clínico e avaliações à distância, interpretar resultados de exames laboratoriais e de imagem, elaborar diagnósticos precisos, propor medidas terapêuticas e orientações de cuidado, reconhecer sinais de risco e gravidade emEndocrinologiae critérios para encaminhar ao atendimento presencial.Atuar de forma a priorizar a prática médica centrada na pessoa.Elaborar planos de tratamento individualizados, levando em consideração as necessidades específicas de cada paciente.Ser hábil na prescrição de medicamentos adequados para tratar doençasEndocrinológicas .Monitorar o progresso dos pacientes ao longo do tratamento em telemedicina.Realizar ajustes no plano de tratamento, conforme necessário, com base na resposta do paciente ao tratamento.Desenvolver atividades integrais de saúde, incorporando prevenção e promoção de saúde para dar as respostas mais adequadas às necessidades de saúde apresentadas.Atender com elevado grau de qualidade, sendo resolutivo na grande maioria das orientações acerca dos principais problemas de saúde emEndocrinologia.Considerar os valores e preferências pessoais do paciente conjuntamente às melhores evidências científicas e à experiência de manejo clínico para efetivamente promover a melhor prática clínica e os melhores desfechos em saúde para cada indivíduo.Exercer uso racional de recursos em saúde visando a segurança do paciente e a prevenção quaternária, evitando sobrediagnóstico e sobretratamento, que expõe os indivíduos a maiores riscos do que benefícios em saúde.Estimular a participação e a autonomia dos indivíduos e familiares, fortalecendo a aderência a tratamentos e medidas de autocuidado.Documentar todas as interações e informações relevantes dos pacientes em prontuários eletrônicos seguros e confidenciais.Ter capacidade de crítica de sua própria atividade médica, considerando-a em seus aspectos científicos, éticos e sociais para aprimoramento contínuo.Manter-se bem-informado e atualizado, ampliando sua própria competência em relação a conhecimentos sobre riscos em saúde e sobre as medidas mais eficientes para eliminar ou reduzir os riscos relevantes.Respeitar, cumprir e fazer cumprir os ditames do Código de Ética Médica, bem como a Legislação vigente e os regulamentos internos formais da Instituição.REQUISITOSFormação Acadêmica: Obrigatório: GRADUAÇÃO EM MEDICINA RESIDÊNCIA MÉDICA OU ESPECIALIZAÇÃO EMENDOCRINOLOGIA, concluída ou em andamento.Certificações: Registro ativo no Conselho Regional de Medicina (CRM);
Certificado de Título de Especialista - RQE (emitido pelo Conselho respectivo) emEndocrinologia, ou comprovante de matrícula em Residência, Pós Graduação, Especialização em Endocrinologia. Certificado Digital Ativo reconhecido pela Infraestrutura de Chaves Públicas Brasileira (ICP-Brasil).Experiência: Experiência em atividades relacionadas à atuação em atendimento médico emEndocrinologia, sendo desejável experiência prévia em Telemedicina e Atenção Primária à Saúde;
Conhecimentos Específicos para a função: Prestar orientações personalizadas a indivíduos e suas famílias com conhecimentos para o diagnóstico, tratamento e acompanhamento de pacientes comdoenças e distúrbios Endócrinos e metabólicos..Competências Comportamentais: Comprometimento com os pacientes, com ideais e valores da empresa, apresentando postura ética, pontualidade, capacidade de integração com equipe multiprofissional.Outros Requisitos Importantes: Conhecimentos e Habilidades em computação: uso do Pacote Office (Excel, Word, Power Point, Gráficos) e Internet. Familiaridade com tecnologias de telemedicina e uso de plataformas de comunicação virtual é um diferencial desejável.Local de Trabalho: REMOTOIMPORTANTE:MODELO DE CONTRATAÇÃO:Contratação em regime de Prestador de Serviços por contrato Pessoa Jurídica, necessário fazer parte como representante legal ou sócio de um CNPJ ativo.REMUNERAÇÃO E AGENDAMENTOS : a negociar durante processo seletivo.Esta descrição de cargo/atuação tem caráter informativo e pode ser ajustada conforme a necessidade da empresa ou instituição que oferece a oportunidade de trabalho em telemedicina para Médico Clínico/Generalista Residente emEndocrinologia.

title: Senior Backend Engineer (Golang)
description:
OPEN TO ALL CANDIDATES ACROSS LATIN AMERICATitle:Senior Backend Engineer (Golang) – Data Infrastructure & Recommendations Company:Fulcrum SaaS Location: Remote – Latin America (strong overlap with Americas time zones required) Type:Full-time Level:Senior / Staff Compensation:USD 70,000–100,000 per year, depending on experience and locationAbout Fulcrum SaaS Fulcrum SaaS is a conversion rate optimization (CRO) platform that powers product recommendations for ecommerce brands. Our infrastructure processes high-volume behavioral events, feeds real-time recommendation algorithms, and serves personalized experiences at scale. We operate in a multi-tenant SaaS environment where data correctness, low latency, and system reliability are non-negotiable. Our stack includes Go, Bigtable, BigQuery, Pub/Sub, and a dual-store architecture (operational + analytical) that we designed from scratch.The Role We are looking for a senior backend engineer who has built and operated production data systems under real load—not prototypes, not internal tools. This is a core infrastructure role at the intersection of our operational and analytical data layers. You will own the systems that move behavioral event data from ingestion through transformation into our recommendation engine. You will design for correctness, build for observability, and make architectural tradeoffs with the pragmatism that only comes from production scars. You will be an early engineering hire with real influence over our technical direction.What You'll Do Design and operate high-throughput event ingestion pipelines capable of processing millions of events per day with low-latency serving requirements. Own the dual-store architecture that separates our operational (real-time) and analytical (batch) data layers, including streaming vs. batch pipeline design and failure recovery. Build and maintain data movement infrastructure between stores (Bigtable/BigQuery or comparable), ensuring consistency, at-least-once delivery, and graceful degradation. Instrument production systems: define SLOs, implement distributed tracing, and build alerting that distinguishes signal from noise. Partner with the recommendation team to evolve our scoring, waterfall, and ranking infrastructure. Drive architectural decisions on data modeling, schema evolution, and multi-tenant isolation. Participate in an on-call rotation and own incidents end-to-end—from detection through root cause analysis to postmortem.What We're Looking For (Must-Haves) 5–10+ years of hands-on backend engineering in production environments (more is better). Track record of building and operating high-performance, high-throughput, low-latency systems at scale—not just prototypes. Deep working knowledge of Go's concurrency model (goroutines, channels, context, sync primitives)—beyond syntax familiarity. Experience with columnar or wide-column stores: Bigtable/BigQuery strongly preferred;
Cassandra, DynamoDB, Redshift, or Snowflake are comparable. Hands-on experience moving data between operational and analytical stores—you have solved streaming vs. batch tradeoffs, handled delivery guarantees, and recovered from pipeline failures. Experience with production observability: metrics, tracing, alerting, dashboards—you know what good instrumentation looks like. Multi-tenant SaaS experience—you understand isolation, scaling, and noisy-neighbor challenges when serving multiple customers on shared infrastructure. Batch pipeline design experience—you know when batch is the right tool and how to make it reliable. Dual-store architecture experience—you have operated systems where the operational and analytical data layers are intentionally separate. Comfortable working daily in English with a US-based team (meetings, async communication, code reviews, and technical documentation).Strong Nice-to-Haves Identity resolution and cross-device stitching (probabilistic or deterministic). A/B testing infrastructure built for statistical rigor—not just feature flags, but impression tracking, experiment analysis, and statistical significance frameworks. Recommendation systems experience: scoring heuristics, waterfall algorithms, collaborative filtering, or hybrid approaches. Ecommerce domain knowledge: attribution models, conversion tracking, order/cart data models, session stitching.What We Offer Compensation in the range of USD 70,000–100,000 per year, depending on experience and location, benchmarked to senior remote engineering roles in LATAM. Remote-first culture with async-friendly practices. Direct access to leadership;
your architectural opinions will be heard and implemented. A team that treats production reliability as a first-class engineering concern.How to Apply Please apply through LinkedIn with your CV (English) and a brief note highlighting: Your experience with Go in production. The most demanding data/throughput system you have owned. Your country of residence and preferred start date. You can also include links to GitHub, technical blogs, or talks if available.

title: Business Strategy Consultant
description:
Organizations collect mountains of data about their customers — and still struggle to act on it. They run surveys, build dashboards, and generate reports, but often lack the structured thinking to turn those outputs into decisions that actually change the business. This role exists to close that gap.Responsibilities: Diagnosing drivers of customer satisfaction, loyalty, and operational performance across enterprise clients. Structuring insights from large datasets and Voice of Customer programs into strategic recommendations. Developing analytical frameworks that connect behavioral and operational data to business outcomes. Building executive presentations and data-driven narratives for C-level and senior stakeholders. Contributing to consulting proposals and new service offerings — translating insights into commercial value propositions. Supporting the development of consulting methodologies, tools, and analytical approaches.Requirements: Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Economics, Engineering, Statistics, Data Science, or Marketing. 3–6 years of experience in roles such as Strategy consulting;
Business analytics or insights;
Strategic planning;
Business intelligence or data-driven product roles. Advanced Excel and PowerPoint skills. Structured problem-solving and analytical framework development. Ability to synthesize qualitative and quantitative inputs into strategic recommendations Fluency in English and Portuguese.Desired Skills: Fluency in Spanish. SQL, Python, or R. Power BI, Tableau, or other BI tools. Experience with customer analytics, Voice of Customer programs, or customer journey analysis.

title: Ai Software Engineer (Full-Stack)
description:

Definir arquitetura e fluxos de usuário utilizando ferramentas e agentes de IA como apoio à geração, testes e evolução de código;
Projetar arquiteturas escaláveis para uso intensivo de LLMs, com foco em performance, disponibilidade e experiência do usuário Desenvolver e manter pipelines de CI/CD e MLOps para entrega contínua e segura de aplicações e modelos;
Garantir qualidade técnica por meio de revisões de código e aderência a boas práticas de engenharia e segurança da informação;
Ser referência técnica no time, contribuindo para a disseminação do desenvolvimento assistido por IA.Competências técnicasSólida base em engenharia de software: algoritmos, design de sistemas e arquitetura full-stack independente de linguagem;
Experiência prática em desenvolvimento assistido por IA, com uso de ferramentas como Cursor, GitHub Copilot ou Replit;
Domínio de ecossistemasde IA: LLMs, Prompt Engineering, RAG, LangChain ou Llama Index;
Experiência com APIs escaláveis, microsserviços e sistemas distribuídos com containers (Docker) e orquestração;
Conhecimento em bancos de dados relacionais e NoSQL;
Capacidade de implementar testes automatizados ao longo do ciclo de vida do software;
Comunicação clara e capacidade de traduzir necessidades de negócio em soluções técnicas viáveis.Conhecimentos desejáveisExperiência com gestão ágil de produtos, incluindo priorização de backlog e alinhamento técnico-negócio;
Fluência em inglês;
Conhecimento em ética de IA, privacidade de dados (LGPD/GDPR) e mitigação de vieses em modelos.Sobre a UPXHá mais de 20 anos, a UPX protege ambientes digitais que não podem falhar. Somos uma empresa norte-americana de cibersegurança que já protegeu mais de 1.000 organizações nos setores financeiro, telecomunicações, cloud, mídia e streaming, jurídico e saúde e que confiam na UPX para manter suas operações no ar 24/7/365.Nosso portfólio integra soluções em Serviços de Segurança Gerenciada AI-driven, Proteção de Borda, Proteção de Endpoints e Segurança de Agentes de IA.Aqui você vai trabalhar com especialistas que operam em ambientes onde o erro tem consequências reais, onde problemas são complexos e o trabalho importa. Se você gosta de pensar no todo, não só na sua parte, você pensa como nós.Acesse upx.Com para saber mais.Siga a UPX nas mídias sociais: Instagram BR | Instagram US | Threads BR | Threads US | TikTok (BR) | LinkedIn | YouTube | X | Reddit

Vivência com sistemas distribuídos e integrações (APIs/microserviços). Experiência com validação de APIs viaPostman ou Insomnia. Experiência comJira e Xray. Uso obrigatório deBDD com Gherkinpara criação e manutenção de cenários. Boa escrita de cenários, critérios de aceite e documentação de evidências. Experiência com testes de regressão e priorização de cenários críticos. Conhecimento obrigatório em JavaScript(não atuará como QE, mas precisa interpretar, ajustar e criar pequenos trechos de código). Experiência sólida comPlaywright(locators, interações, assertions, waits, screenshots e vídeos). Experiência comCI/CD e execução de testes em pipelines (ex.: Jenkins). Conhecimento emDockere ambientes conteinerizados.DiferenciaisNoções de observabilidade (Dynatrace, Loki). Experiência com jornadas deCheckout e Pagamentos (Pix, boleto, cartão). Noções de segurança/controles (ex.: PCI) aplicados a testes. Conhecimento básico emAWS ou ambientes cloud (multi-account) .Sobre a OSF DigitalA OSF Digital tem orgulho de ser uma empresa que oferece oportunidades iguais, onde você pode ser você mesmo no trabalho. title: Brazil Senior Condition Intelligence (Ci & Pm)

We're building world-class commercial capabilities to support this growth journey.Role Description As a Condition Intelligence (CI) Specialist at Dingo, you will be at the heart of delivering data-driven insights that help our clients across the Americas protect their most critical assets. Your mission is to transform fluid, sensor, and digital inspection data into clear, actionable recommendations that prevent mobile and fixed-plant breakdowns, extend component life, and eliminate unplanned downtime. In this pivotal role, you will collaborate closely within then Dingo Technical Services team to monitor asset health remotely, assess component-level risk, and guide operational decisions that directly impact productivity, safety, and cost efficiency. You will be instrumental in harnessing Dingo's advanced analytics and AI-driven capabilities to proactively engage client to identify risks before they escalate, ensuring consistently measurable results. With a primary focus on our rapidly growing North and South American customer base, you will combine technical expertise with strong communication skills to deliver timely, trusted advice, strengthening long-term partnerships. In a mining sector increasingly focused on efficiency, sustainability, and predictive maintenance, your work will be a key driver in cementing Dingo's reputation as the leader in asset health intelligence.Condition Data Analysis & Diagnostics – Review and interpret condition management data from both mobile and fixed plant assets to diagnose component-level risks. Apply domain expertise to determine root causes, assess severity, and prioritize corrective actions based on operational impact, safety, and mission criticality. Rules-Based Analytics Development – Create and refine rules-based analytics to enable swift detection of emerging issues. Ensure diagnostic models and alert parameters support early intervention, reducing downtime and extending component life. Technical Support & Collaboration – Provide expert guidance to Dingo teams on component health assessments, lubrication strategies, and condition management best practices. Act as a trusted technical resource for troubleshooting and advanced diagnostics. Customer Communication & Maintenance Recommendations – Follow up on flagged components or lubricant issues, translating complex technical data into clear, actionable maintenance recommendations for customers. Ensure communications are timely, accurate, and aligned with customer priorities. Quality Observation Reviews – Deliver high-quality, daily observation reviews and actionable insights, consistently applying safety-first principles and considering operational mission criticality. Data Accuracy & System Integrity – Monitor the condition management software database to ensure data accuracy, resolve discrepancies, and maintain the integrity of condition records. Lubricated Component Health Assessment – Evaluate the condition of lubricated components to identify opportunities for extending asset life through on-condition maintenance changes. Customer Engagement & Follow-Up – Organize and lead remote Condition Management follow-up meetings with customers and internal teams to confirm satisfaction, address concerns, and reinforce positive engagement experiences. Diagnostic Tools & Guideline Development – Assist in developing structured diagnostic guidelines, contamination troubleshooting processes, and detailed repair procedures to support consistent, high-quality component health management.Qualifications Experience – Minimum of five (5) years' experience in heavy industrial equipment maintenance within industrial or mining environments;
OR a Mechanical or Mining Engineering degree with at least two (2) years of relevant experience. Hands-on background as a shop or field mechanic for industrial mining equipment is highly desirable. Industry Knowledge – Strong familiarity with mining and industrial maintenance principles, including mechanical systems, equipment design, and repair processes. Lubrication & Condition Monitoring Expertise – In-depth understanding of lubrication applications, maintenance principles, familiarity in onboard machine telemetry and/or OEM condition monitoring reporting systems, and the use of condition monitoring technologies and tools to inform proactive maintenance strategies. Technical Proficiency – Proven ability to use data and factual analysis to troubleshoot issues, solve problems, and make informed operational decisions. Linguistic Proficiency – Fluency in English is essential for clear and effective communication with customers and internal teams. A high degree of proficiency in Spanish or French is a strong advantage for engaging with a broader range of stakeholders. Communication & Leadership – Excellent verbal and written communication skills, coupled with strong information management capabilities. Demonstrated ability to lead interactions with both internal teams and external customers, building trust and alignment.

This role is heavily backend and API-driven, with a strong emphasis on asynchronous processing, system-to-system integration, and resilient service design. The engineer will work on both net-new services and enhancements to existing systems, collaborating closely with product owners and other engineering teams.Key Responsibilities
- Design, build, and enhance backend services using .NET and C#
- Develop RESTful APIs and backend components that operate within distributed systems
- Build and maintain asynchronous processing workflows using messaging patterns
- Upgrade and modernize existing .NET applications (e.G. .NET 8 to .NET 10)
- Implement system-to-system integrations, including external-facing services
- Consume and process messages from event-driven sources, handling retries and failure scenarios
- Participate in unit and integration testing as part of CI/CD pipelines
- Deploy services to Kubernetes environments in AWS
- Collaborate with product owners, engineers, and cross-functional teams in a ticket-driven environment
- Contribute to design discussions with a system-wide, not just code-level, mindsetTechnical Requirements
- Strong proficiency with C# and modern .NET development
- Experience building backend services and RESTful APIs
- Solid understanding of distributed systems and asynchronous processing
- Hands-on experience with event-driven architectures (pub/sub, messaging systems)
- Experience working in AWS environments
- Familiarity with Kubernetes-based deployments (e.G. EKS)
- Experience using relational databases (e.G. AWS RDS)
- Exposure to CI/CD pipelines, preferably GitHub Actions
- Experience with unit testing and integration testing in .NET applicationsPreferred / Nice to Have
- Experience with AWS messaging services such as SNS and SQS
- Familiarity with Infrastructure as Code tools such as Terraform
- Experience deploying applications via GitHub Actions
- Exposure to configuration management patterns (e.G. externalized config services)
- Experience working alongside teams using different technology stacks (e.G. Clojure or functional programming environments)
- Familiarity with authentication and service-to-service security (e.G. Okta)
- Comfort using AI-assisted development tools such as GitHub CopilotWork Environment & Team Culture
- Backend-heavy role with minimal frontend expectations
- Collaborative, low-micromanagement engineering culture
- Engineers are expected to work independently but ask questions when needed
- Ticket-driven work with varying levels of requirement detail
- Strong emphasis on respectful cross-team collaboration
- Encouragement of thoughtful technical pushback and design discussions
- Regular pairing and open communication via Slack and ad-hoc calls
- Focus on sustainable delivery rather than perfection under time constraintsWhat Success Looks Like
- Quickly ramping into existing systems and development patterns
- Owning backend services end to end, from design through deployment
- Demonstrating a strong systems mindset beyond individual features
- Building reliable, maintainable services within a distributed architecture
- Collaborating effectively across teams with different technical bac

title: Account Manager
description: As anAccount Manager for Brazil, you'll join our passionate and supportive team characterised by our ambition and team spirit. You'll have the freedom to work independently while fostering strong collaboration with our content and product departments.You'll be responsible for driving the entire sales and success cycle in the iGaming market, from initial engagement to maximizing long-term results. Managing key client relationships, driving sales growth, and ensuring customer satisfaction within these specific regions. This role requires a proactive approach to identifying opportunities, understanding client needs, and delivering tailored solutions that drive mutual success.Specifically, your role will involve:Develop and maintain strong relationships with key clients, including sports betting operators, casinos, online gaming platforms, and other relevant stakeholders. Act as the primary point of contact for key client accounts, managing all aspects of the client relationship and serving as their trusted advisor. Understand clients' business objectives, market trends, and regulatory requirements specific to the English speaking markets to effectively position our gambling products and services. Collaborate with internal sales, marketing, and product development teams to customize solutions and address client needs within these regions. Proactively identify opportunities for upselling additional products/services and expanding client accounts. Prepare and deliver compelling sales presentations, proposals, and business cases to key clients within these regions. Monitor and analyze sales performance, market trends, and competitor activities to identify opportunities for growth and optimization within key accounts. Attend industry events, conferences, and trade shows worldwide to network with key clients and stay informed about industry insights and developments. Provide timely and accurate reports on key account performance, sales activity, and revenue forecasts within these regions to management. Stay up-to-date on gambling regulations, compliance standards, and responsible gaming practices to ensure adherence and mitigate risks.The ideal profileWe're on the lookout for someone who not only shares our values and ambitions but also envisions growing alongside MoveUp Media. As a dedicated team player, you embody fair play, transparency, agility, and an unstoppable drive. You're the perfect fit for our team if you:Have outstanding written and verbal communication skills in Brazilian Portuguese and English. Understand gambling products, platforms, and regulations in specific regions. Drive change and support accounts in the iGaming industry with your sales skills. Be ambitious, adaptable, and thrive in fast-paced environments. Focus on exceeding sales targets and driving revenue growth. Bring experience in iGaming strategy, sales, or affiliate management. Excel in building and maintaining strong relationships with partners. Possess excellent communication and negotiation skills. Show active listening, resilience, and persistence. Demonstrate strong problem-solving abilities and effective task coordination. Excel in time management, organization, and planning. Manage multiple accounts and tasks simultaneously. Use analytical skills and a data-driven mindset for decision-making. Thrive in teamwork and adapt well to evolving environments. Be open to occasional travel for client meetings and industry events.Feeling up to the task of managing the main challenges of the role, even without meeting all criteria? We're eager to hear from you! We know not all great candidates will match 100% of the above.Next steps in the process First Interview:A conversation with your future manager to ensure you meet the role's requirements. Second Interview:A chat with HR to understand you better and ensure a cultural fit with MoveUp Media. Final Step:A proposition for us to start working together!What's in it for youRemote Work Environment:Enjoy the flexibility of working remotely full-time. Flexible Schedule:We measure results, not hours, and offer paid time off. Development Opportunities:As a rapidly growing startup, we offer numerous possibilities for career advancement and support your career path. Team Gatherings:Annual team get-togethers to connect, work, and have fun. We strive to find enjoyable spots for everyone. Wellness Fund:€1,000 per year dedicated to your professional development, sports, or cultural events of your choice.MoveUp MediaWe're a dynamic and driven team that's all about growth. Partnering with top-notch brands in the exciting worlds of iGaming and sports, we're on a mission to connect sports fans to global advertisers. SEO is our bread and butter, and we're relentless in our pursuit of getting our websites to the top of search results for all the best—and sometimes toughest—keywords.With bases in both France and Brazil, we're making waves across 20+ markets. And here's the best part: we're a 100% remote team that thrives on efficiency and flexibility. So if you're ready to join a company that's all about results and values your work-life balance, we'd love to hear from you!Here at MoveUp Media, we believe in the power of diversity and inclusion. We are committed to providing equal opportunities for all individuals, regardless of their background, race, gender, sexual orientation, or abilities. We celebrate the unique perspectives and talents that each person brings to the table, and we strive to create a welcoming and supportive environment where everyone can thrive and succeed. We firmly believe that a diverse workforce leads to greater teamwork and success. Join us in our journey towards a more inclusive and equitable future! title: Data Engineer Iii
description:

A equipe trabalha em estreita colaboração com liderança, finanças, operações e stakeholders do negócio para viabilizar acesso confiável a dados de alta qualidade, apoiar análises avançadas e impulsionar ações orientadas por dados em toda a organização. O(a) Engenheiro(a) de Dados terá um papel crítico no desenho, construção e manutenção de pipelines de dados robustos, modelos de dados e ativos fundamentais que suportam analytics, relatórios e capacidades emergentes de IA/ML. Essa função exige forte rigor em engenharia, profundo entendimento de sistemas de dados e capacidade de colaborar entre equipes técnicas e de negócio. O(a) candidato(a) ideal possui um histórico comprovado na construção de soluções de dados escaláveis em ambientes dinâmicos e multifuncionais, e sente-se confortável equilibrando trabalho em plataformas de dados fundamentais com iniciativas em evolução de analytics e IA.O que você fará Você possui uma forte mentalidade de engenharia e resolução de problemas. Converte necessidades de negócio e analíticas em soluções e arquiteturas de dados escaláveis e confiáveis. Projeta, constrói e mantém pipelines e modelos de dados escaláveis que suportam monitoramento de desempenho do negócio, analytics e relatórios, além de contribuir para o desenvolvimento da Base de Dados BMP em ambientes Hive, Snowflake e data lakes. Apoia o desenvolvimento de produtos e aplicações de dados, incluindo contribuição em pipelines baseados em Streamlit e no desenvolvimento de capacidades de chatbot para melhorar o acesso e a interação com dados. Colabora de perto com equipes de analytics, ciência de dados e áreas de negócio para garantir disponibilidade, qualidade e usabilidade dos dados para dashboards, relatórios e análises avançadas. Viabiliza e apoia o desenvolvimento de analytics avançado, machine learning e capacidades de IA, garantindo que a infraestrutura, pipelines e ambientes necessários estejam disponíveis para o desenvolvimento e implantação de modelos. Contribui para o design e evolução do ecossistema de dados e ML, ajudando a estabelecer infraestrutura, processos e fundamentos necessários para escalar iniciativas de IA/ML na organização.Qualificações Mínimas
- Mestrado em Ciência da Computação, Engenharia de Dados, Engenharia ou área quantitativa relacionada.
- Mais de 5 anos de experiência em engenharia de dados, desenvolvimento de plataformas de dados ou funções relacionadas.
- Forte experiência com SQL e pelo menos uma linguagem de programação (Python ou equivalente).
- Familiaridade com frameworks de big data e processamento distribuído (ex.: Spark / PySpark).
- Experiência na construção e manutenção de pipelines de dados e trabalho com arquiteturas modernas de dados.
- Experiência com ferramentas de orquestração (ex.: Airflow) e automação de pipelines.
- Experiência com plataformas de dados em nuvem (ex.: AWS) e soluções de data warehouse (ex.: Snowflake).

title: Ai Evaluation Engineer
description: About FirstIgnite FirstIgnite is the AI-powered business development platform for university technology transfer offices (TTOs). We help research institutions turn breakthroughs into partnerships, licenses, and companies by combining deep LLM-driven workflows with the relationships that actually move deals forward. Our product suite spans expert discovery, grants search, and AI-driven outreach — all built on a modern, agentic stack. We ship fast, we measure everything, and we believe evaluations are the difference between AI features that demo well and AI features that work in production.The Role We're hiring an AI Evaluation Engineer to own the quality bar for every LLM-powered feature we ship. You'll design, build, and scale the infrastructure that tells us — with evidence — whether a prompt change, model swap, or agent refactor made things better or worse. This is a high-leverage role. Every customer-facing AI capability at FirstIgnite flows through your evals. You'll work directly with the Head of Engineering and partner closely with product, applied AI, and the full-stack team to establish evaluation as a first-class discipline across the company.What You'll Do Build evaluation infrastructure:Design and maintain eval suites using Promptfoo, LLM-as-judge methodologies, and custom harnesses for features like our expert search system, natural language grants search, and AI SDR agents. Define what 'good' means:Partner with product and domain experts to translate fuzzy customer outcomes (\ "does this surface the right principal investigator?\ ") into precise, measurable rubrics. Own the feedback loop:Instrument production traffic, curate golden datasets from real customer interactions, and build pipelines that turn user behavior into regression tests. Ship quickly under uncertainty:We routinely run 48-hour eval sprints for greenfield features with no production traffic. You'll be comfortable bootstrapping quality signal from scratch. Model and prompt evaluation:Run rigorous A/B comparisons across models (OpenAI, Anthropic, open-weight), prompt strategies, and agent architectures. Quantify tradeoffs between cost, latency, and quality. Agent evaluation:Help us measure multi-step agent behavior built on the OpenAI Agents SDK, Vercel AI SDK, and Temporal Cloud — including tool-use correctness, trajectory quality, and end-to-end task completion. Raise the floor for the team:Create templates, documentation, and tooling so every engineer can write and run evals as part of normal development. Evals should feel as natural as unit tests.Requirements 3+ years of engineering experience, with at least 1 year focused on LLM/ML evaluation, applied AI, or data quality systems. Hands-on experience with LLM evaluation frameworks — Promptfoo, Braintrust, LangSmith, OpenAI Evals, DeepEval, or equivalent in-house tooling. Strong grasp of LLM-as-judge methodology, including its failure modes (position bias, verbosity bias, judge-model drift) and how to mitigate them. Statistical literacy — you know the difference between a real regression and noise, and you can design experiments that answer the question actually being asked. Product instincts. You can sit with a customer success call transcript, identify the three failure modes that matter, and ship an eval for each by end of week. Strong written communication. Evals are useless if the engineers shipping features don't trust or read the results.Preferred Qualifications Experience evaluating retrieval systems (RAG, hybrid search, reranking) — especially over structured or semi-structured domains like research, grants, or patents. Exposure to agent orchestration frameworks (Temporal, LangGraph, OpenAI Agents SDK) and the specific challenges of evaluating multi-step, tool-using systems. Background in information retrieval, search relevance, or a research-adjacent domain. Experience building internal tooling or dashboards that non-engineers (PMs, domain experts) actually use to label and review model outputs.Why This Role You'll be the first dedicated evals hire. The scope, standards, and tooling are yours to define. AI quality is existential for our product. This isn't a compliance role tucked into a corner — it's directly on the critical path to revenue. Small, senior team. ~10 engineers, distributed globally, with a strong bias toward shipping and measuring. Direct access to real-world, high-stakes LLM use cases — research discovery, grants, outbound — across a customer base that deeply values accuracy.This is a fully remote position. We have engineers across the Americas, Europe, and Africa. Overlap with US working hours is expected.

title: Senior Data Scientist/Ai Engineer
description:

title: Software Engineer
description: Exciting New Career Opportunity:Software Engineer - Quality & AI Infrastructure Company:Hirebus Location:Remote in Brazil Pay:$30K-$60K per yearWe're hiring a mid-level engineer to own two things: the quality of our codebase and the early foundations of our AI agent work.The role Most of your time will be spent making our existing software more reliable. You'll dig into production bugs, trace them to root cause, and write the tests that should have caught them. You'll review pull requests in a way that raises the bar without demoralizing anyone. You'll tackle the tech debt that everyone complains about in retros but nobody picks up.The other part — and this is growing — is our AI agent work. We're building tooling, orchestration, and evaluation systems for LLM-powered features. This isn't a research project. It's production software that needs the same rigor as everything else we ship. We need someone who can bring that rigor.What you'll do Debug and fix issues across the stack, from staging through production Build meaningful test coverage (the kind that actually catches regressions) Review code thoroughly — with context, not just style nits Refactor the parts of the codebase that slow the team down Help define how we ship: observability, release process, quality gates Work with product and design to land features cleanly Contribute to our AI agent infrastructure: tool-calling, orchestration, evaluation, safetyTechnical Requirements 7+ years of professional engineering experience with a track record of shipping production SaaS products Expert in Node.Js, React, and TypeScript with strong product architecture instincts (scalability, maintainability, speed of iteration) Hands-on Supabase experience: Postgres schema design, RLS policies, edge functions, and auth Shipped production LLM-powered features (OpenAI, Anthropic, or similar) with a working understanding of prompt engineering, evals, latency/cost tradeoffs, and guardrails Experience building agentic workflows, RAG systems, or tool-use integrations (MCP, function calling) Excellent written English and self-directed async work style, with meaningful overlap with US Mountain Time Comfortable using AI-native development tools (Claude Code, Cursor, or similar) as part of daily workflowYour first 90 days: Month 1: You've shipped real bug fixes. You're in the PR review rotation and contributing useful feedback. You have context on the parts of the system that break most often. Month 2: Test coverage in your area has improved measurably. You've identified at least one chunk of tech debt worth prioritizing and started on it. Month 3: You've shipped a meaningful refactor. You've made your first contributions to the AI agent infrastructure — something concrete, with results we can point to.We're not looking for someone who wants to rewrite everything from scratch. We want someone who makes the team steadily better — through reliable fixes, honest reviews, and the kind of infrastructure work that compounds over time. If you're also curious about what engineering looks like as AI agents become part of the workflow, even better.

Manage and maintain overall solution architecture, scalability, and integrity. Provides hands-on support to developers (e.G., resolving technical blockers and reviewing code) Other job duties and projects as assigned.QualificationsBachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, or a related field (or equivalent experience) 5+ years of experience in SAP Master Data GovernanceRequired SkillsStrong hands-on experience with SAP MDG-BP, MDG-M, MDG-F, or MDG-S. Solid understanding of data governance frameworks and master data lifecycle Experience configuring: Data Models & Change Request Types, BRF+ Rules, Workflow, Data Replication Framework (DRF) Knowledge of Fiori apps and MDG UI customization Collaboration: Work closely with cross-functional teams, including data analysts, IT, and business stakeholders, to ensure seamless integration and alignment of MDG solutions. Training and Support: Provide training and support to team members and end-users on MDG best practices and solutions. Provide regular reports on system health and performance. Knowledge of agile methodologies and frameworks such as Kanban as well as use of tools like Jira and Service Now. Facilitate work and resource estimation, track progress, provide escalations and status updates.Preferred SkillsSAP MDG Certification

title: Senior Estimator
description:

Review the Project Plan along with the project planner and prepare subcontract scope packages for any work that is required to be subcontracted. Generate estimates with available Benchmark data and from experience prior to receiving the inputs from functions and evaluate the estimates received from functions against the internal estimate Liaise with Project Team members plus all functional departments based on the specific functions allotted for a project, subcontractors and vendors, and Customer;
including Procurement, Fabrication, Marine, Quality, HSES, Completions, and Welding Technology Provide input to the Project Estimators, along with Basis of Estimate and Bench Markers Give regular updates to the department manager/PMT /immediate supervisor and highlight any concerns about anything that might potentially jeopardize submitting a competitive proposal. Analyze the cost components that are critical/crucial and seek quotes for applicable items. Participate in Bid review meetings, estimate evaluation meetings, Risk assessment meetings, as well as any additional bid-related meetings, as required. Prepare a comprehensive Basis of Estimate (BOE). Review and identify contract price form. Understand and clarify unit rate and lump sum breakdowns. Accurately manage all the Previous Tender information and Treat it with Confidentiality Utilize support from the benchmarking team (SMEs) by analyzing information on the costs from other similar projects and preparing the relevant benchmark report. Attend and participate in Bid review meetings, estimate evaluation meetings, Risk assessment meetings, etc., as necessary for the Project/Department/Tender Participate in HAZAN, HAZID, HAZOP, and other safety /operability/ reliability studies and workshops, as necessary for Project/Tender Ensure any Risk or Opportunity highlighted is Duly captured for the Management review and approval. Post Tender submission provide input for the clarification. Support bid handover process ensuring proper transfer of pricing basis and critical assumptions to project team. Manage own time to meet objectives;
forecast and plan resource requirements. Incorporate project planner input to develop the cost. Assure that the estimate is: Completed promptly Cognizant of the Bid 'Win Strategy' Aligned with planned schedeule All the Risk and Opportunities highlighted. With Due Basis of Estimate Accurate, free of errors, omission, or hidden contingency In line with the agreed execution plan Evaluate and recommend ways to be more cost-effective or profitableQualifications: Bachelor's Degree in Engineering or related technical discipline preferred. Equivalent experience will be considered. Five plus (5+) years of experience in a large Engineering, Procurement, and Construction (EPC) company (preferably in Offshore/Marine Operations, and offshore estimation, ). Subsea/SURF experience with Minimum 3–5 years of direct experience in subsea/SURF construction estimation, including deepwater pipeline installation, flexible/umbilical lay, subsea structure installation, and marine spread costs. Experience with DSV, PLSV, and/or Heavy Construction Vessel (HCV) spread rate estimation strongly preferred. Cost estimation experience, preferably in the Oil & Gas industry Willingness to work overtime as necessary to meet deadlines Intermediate level in Microsoft Office systems, e.G., Excel, Word, Outlook, PowerPoint, Project Accurately evaluate detailed specifications that are crucial to a cost estimator's success Must pay attention to minute details because such details may impact a product's overall cost Must plan their work and work efficiently and accurately.

title: Solution Consultant
description:
Employment Type:Full-time position employed by a partner agency (3rd party, B2B)About Sisense Sisense is a leading AI-powered Analytics Platform as a Service (AnPaaS) that empowers product teams and developers to embed conversational, predictive, and agentic intelligence directly into applications and workflows. Our API-first, developer-first platform turns complex data into faster, smarter, actionable decisions for over 2,000 global customers across financial services, retail, healthcare, and technology. With the recent launch of Sisense Intelligence, including the Intelligence Assistant (natural-language analytics creation), Model Context Protocol (MCP) server (secure external LLM integration), and Managed LLM capabilities, we're accelerating innovation in embedded analytics, enabling governed, scalable AI experiences at enterprise scale.The Role As a Solution Consultant on our Field Engineering team, you will serve as a trusted technical advisor to strategic customers, guiding them through complex analytics and data initiatives to achieve measurable business outcomes. You will lead technical discovery, design best-practice solution architectures, and partner closely with customers and internal teams to ensure successful, scalable deployments across cloud-native and embedded environments.Why Join Our Field Engineering Services Team You'll operate at the intersection of customer success, product innovation, and business impact. This role gives you direct influence over high-value implementations, the opportunity to shape product direction through customer insights, and the chance to work on cutting-edge AI-embedded analytics projects with global enterprises. You'll collaborate with diverse teams while driving real value for customers and contributing to Sisense's growth.Responsibilities Partner directly with customers to accelerate analytics initiatives, recommend scalable architectures, and align technical solutions with long-term business goals. Lead deep technical discovery sessions to understand customer data maturity, use cases, and operational constraints. Own the technical customer relationship as a trusted advisor, guiding solution design across cloud-native, embedded, and secure analytics environments. Design, review, and optimize data models, queries, and analytical workflows to support performant, scalable solutions. Deliver onboarding sessions, solution walkthroughs, and enablement workshops tailored to customers with intermediate to advanced data and analytics maturity. Create and deliver customized technical presentations and demonstrations for audiences ranging from hands-on practitioners to executive stakeholders. Provide guidance on authentication, security, and access control concepts, including SSO patterns and user-level data access strategies. Consult on embedding analytics into applications, including session handling and integration best practices. Support solution reviews, migrations, upgrades, and architectural optimizations across customer environments. Assist customers with platform administration and configuration tasks, including API automation and environment setup. Collaborate closely with internal engineering, product, and support teams to surface customer feedback, identify issues, and influence future enhancements. Capture and share best practices, reference architectures, and technical assets to scale knowledge across customers and internal teams. Evangelize Sisense best practices through workshops, community engagement, and technical thought leadership.About You 3-5+ years of experience in a technical, customer-facing role (e.G., Solution Consultant, Pre-Sales Engineer, Technical Consultant, Implementation Specialist, or similar). Hands-on experience with modern BI and analytics platforms (Sisense preferred;
Tableau, Looker, Power BI, or similar acceptable). Proven success leading or contributing to complex BI, cloud, or data platform implementations, from discovery through delivery. Strong data modeling expertise within a BI context, including dimensional modeling and working with large, complex datasets. SQL proficiency: understands join types, normalization - has the ability to join data across disparate sources, optimize queries, and design efficient analytical models. Experience designing and delivering customized technical presentations and product demonstrations for audiences ranging from hands-on practitioners to executive stakeholders. Ability to translate technical concepts into clear business value, adapting communication style to technical and non-technical audiences alike. Solid technical foundation, including experience with: JavaScript, HTML/CSS (nice to have;
strong preference for hands-on exposure) REST APIs and platform integrations Linux-based environments and containerized architectures (Docker, Kubernetes) Experience providing guidance on authentication and security, including implementing or supporting SSO solutions (SAML 2.0, OIDC, JWT). Detailed understanding of analytics embedding, including hands-on implementation using iFrames and related integration patterns. Working knowledge of ETL methodologies, data pipelines, and upstream data preparation concepts. Nice to have: prior experience with technical project management or leading workstreams across cross-functional teams.What We Offer Employment through a partner agency (B2B). Competitive base salary up to USD 4300 per month (depending on experience). Opportunity to work with a global leader in AI-powered embedded analytics. Flexible remote work with a collaborative international team. Professional development and growth opportunities.

title: Ai Reasoning Engineer (Mathematics & Python)
description: Company Description MillionLogics, a trusted Oracle Partner, is a global IT solutions provider with offices in London, UK, and a development hub in Hyderabad, India. The company specializes in delivering smart, scalable, and future-ready IT solutions to empower businesses to evolve and lead. With expertise in Data & AI, Cloud migrations, IT consulting, and enterprise application optimization, MillionLogics offers tailored services with a focus on client success. Supported by a team of over 50 AI & Oracle experts, MillionLogics combines cutting-edge technology with a commitment to delivering impactful outcomes. Learn more about our services on our website.Role Description We are seeking a highly analytical and computationally proficient individual to join our team with a strong research background. You will be instrumental in contributing to this role by either crafting challenging and insightful problems in your respective research domain, devising elegant computational solutions.Offer Details: Pay: $1500 per month (Net/take-home) Mode of work - Fully RemoteResponsibilities: Build multi-agent benchmark tasks that require multi-step mathematical reasoning, proof construction, or algorithmic problem-solving Design problems that are genuinely hard for a single agent but decomposable — competition math, numerical analysis, combinatorial optimization, statistical inference Create verification scripts that check mathematical correctness — numerical answers with appropriate tolerance, proof step validity, algorithm output correctness Write clear problem statements with precise notation, definitions, and output format Create decomposition guides that split problems into independent sub-computations or parallel solution strategiesRequired Qualifications: 5+ years in mathematics, quantitative research, or computational science — competition math, university-level mathematics, or quantitative research background Python programming — NumPy, SciPy, or symbolic computation (SymPy) Experience writing mathematical proofs or formal derivations. Ability to create problems with precise, verifiable answers — not subjective or open-ended. Experience with AI coding benchmarks (SWE-bench, Terminal-bench) Comfortable with Docker — writing Dockerfiles, building images, and debugging container issues. Understanding of numerical methods — floating point tolerance, convergence criteria, error bounds.Strong plus: Experience creating math competition problems (AMC, AIME, Putnam, IMO, or similar). Research in mathematics, theoretical CS, or quantitative fields. Experience with automated theorem proving or formal verification. Knowledge of AI reasoning benchmarks (GSM8K, MATH, AIME, GPQA, ARC-AGI). Experience with large-scale numerical computation or scientific computingExample of what you will produce: A task requiring analysis of a system of 50 coupled differential equations modeling a chemical reaction network. The agent must determine equilibrium concentrations, stability conditions, and bifurcation points. Input includes the reaction network as a matrix, rate constants, and initial conditions. The verifier checks numerical answers with tolerance (1e-6), validates eigenvalue analysis for stability, and confirms bifurcation parameter ranges. The decomposition splits into 4 sub-agents: one computes equilibria, one analyzes local stability, one maps bifurcations, and one synthesizes the phase portrait. Oracle scores 1.0, single-agent scores 0.25, multi-agent scores 0.80.Offer Details: Commitments Required: 8 hours per day with a 4-hour overlap with PST. Employment Type: Contractor position (Note: this role does not include medical/paid leave). Duration of Contract: 6months (expected start date is next week).How to Apply? Please send us your updated CV towithjob ID 75046in the email subject line.

FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ (“FWWC2027”), which for the first time ever is hosted in South America in Brazil. The Head of Brand & Marketing at FWWC27 LTDA, which is FIFA’s Brazilian subsidiary responsible for the delivery of FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027 Brazil (TM), will be tasked to guide and implement brand and marketing plans, campaigns and activations in line with the marketing & communication strategy. This role is critical to the success of the first ever FIFA Women’s World Cup to be held in South America with a vision to unite the world through an unprecedented experience that celebrates and elevates women’s football.

Key Responsibilities
  • Act as an extension to, and be part of the global MBBI (Marketing, Brand, Business Intelligence) team based in Zurich with dual reporting lines, for being a key representative to all Brand, Marketing and Promotion Tournament matters.
  • Responsible for all promotional aspects including any communications designed and required to support the commercial and marketing objectives of the tournament.
  • Be the main liaison for Host Country and Host City representatives, tournament executive leadership representing the MBBI team.
  • Lead the local, regional and national delivery of various marketing campaigns and initiatives related to, and beyond identified tournament milestones.
  • Lead a team of brand & marketing professionals on the ground, and ensure seamless cooperation, collaboration and integration with all relevant functional areas at FWWC27 LTDA and FIFA’s head office in Zurich, as well as any other functional areas such as legal, finance, etc.
  • Identify and communicate opportunities to create dedicated local, regional or national promotional activities that support the objectives of the tournament, the marketing strategy, or any relevant stakeholders such as commercial partners, media partners, host cities, and others.
  • Identify and drive commercial value through the marketing of the tournament’s brand assets and intellectual property, including but not limited to mascots, licensing & retail, the FIFA Fan Festival, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027 Trophy Tour, official music tracks/album/sonic identities, and other.
  • Contribute to, and drive implementation of ticketing & hospitality go-to-market strategy and activations plans.
  • Establish and maintain strong and impactful relationships with relevant partners, celebrities, influencers, key event organizers, agencies, etc.
  • Manage and maintain budget and liaise with the relevant colleagues in Zurich in all matters budget and spend.
  • Oversee the correct implementation and utilization of all in-market tournament brand asset implementations and applications including, but not limited to, event and stadium dressing, experiential marketing applications, retail branding, and any other use of the brand assets by FIFA’s internal and external stakeholders.
  • Manage procurement and legal processes (in compliance with FWWC27 LTDA policies and guidelines) as it relates to the tendering and contracting of local, regional or national suppliers, service providers, agencies, and other.
  • Manage and deliver all necessary reporting measures related to the tournament.
  • Drive and manage effective communications between the relevant functional areas and, in particular with the MBBI team in Zurich.

  • Bachelor’s degree or similar higher education in marketing, or a marketing related discipline.

  • Desenvolver, implementar e gerenciar políticas e procedimentos de segurança específicos para operações onshore e offshore, alinhados com as regulamentações e padrões da empresa.

  • Experiência em funções relacionadas à saúde e segurança ocupacional, preferencialmente em ambientes industriais ou de grande porte.
  • Conhecimento sólido das normas regulamentadoras (NRs), técnicas de investigação de incidentes e outras legislações aplicáveis à saúde e segurança no trabalho.
  • Necessária experiência com O&G e regulamentos técnicos da ANP (SGSO, SGIP, SGSS, etc.).
  • Habilidades analíticas e capacidade de conduzir investigações de acidentes e análises de riscos.
  • Excelentes habilidades de comunicação oral e escrita.
  • Gestão de pessoas.

title: Diretor(A) De Arte
description:
Na V3A, a cultura aparece nas escolhas que fazemos: o que priorizamos, como decidimos e o nível de resultado que esperamos entregar. Acreditamos em performance com responsabilidade, autonomia com atitude e crescimento baseado em resultados, bem como a prevalência de times foda! Valorizamos quem assume o protagonismo e joga para ganhar, sempre respeitando nossos acordos, processos e, principalmente, pessoas. Nossa régua é alta, engloba escolhas assertivas, excelência na execução e prioridade à experiência de marca dos nossos steakholders. ✨

Sobre a vaga

Buscamos um(a) Designer com olhar apurado e alta capacidade de execução. Essa pessoa será responsável por transformar conceitos em conteúdos visuais relevantes, garantindo agilidade, consistência e alinhamento com as diretrizes da marca. Além da produção contínua para social e ads, também irá contribuir com o desenvolvimento de key visuals e direções visuais, apoiando campanhas e iniciativas estratégicas.

Atividades e Responsabilidades
  • Criação de peças para social e ads: desenvolver conteúdos visuais para redes sociais e mídia paga, adaptados a diferentes formatos, plataformas e objetivos.
  • Criação de materiais institucionais internos: desenvolver apresentações, comunicados visuais e outros materiais voltados para stakeholders internos, garantindo clareza, consistência e alinhamento com a identidade da marca.
  • Pesquisa e repertório visual: buscar referências, acompanhar tendências e realizar benchmarks com olhar apurado para transformar insights em peças e vídeos relevantes.
  • Desenvolvimento de Campanhas Digitais e Key Visuals: criar conceitos visuais e key visuals para campanhas e conteúdos digitais.
  • Adaptação e desdobramento: adaptar e escalar conteúdos para diferentes canais, garantindo consistência visual e eficiência na produção.
  • Colaboração criativa: participar de brainstorms e contribuir com ideias que conectem tendências, cultura e linguagem visual aos projetos.
Requisitos e Habilidades
  • Habilidade na criação de peças gráficas, com foco em engajamento, performance e aderência ao formato de cada canal.
  • Capacidade de pensar fora da caixa, propondo abordagens visuais autênticas e conectadas com o público.
  • Capacidade de trabalhar dentro de uma identidade visual consistente, garantindo alinhamento com a voz e o posicionamento das marcas.
  • Facilidade para trabalhar em equipe, lidar com prazos dinâmicos e se adaptar rapidamente às demandas do dia a dia.
  • Domínio completo do pacote Adobe: Illustrator, Photoshop e Indesign como prioridade.
  • Noção de edição de vídeos básica para redes sociais.

Se você é apaixonado por design, inovação e quer fazer parte de projetos criativos e desafiadores, vem criar com a V3A! #V3AExperiênciaDeMarca

  • Experiência com gestão de funil e otimização de conversão

Será um diferencial:

title: Medico Neuropediatra Diarista- Hospital Cardoso Fontes
description:
Job type: Full-time employee

Desde dezembro de 2024 a SPDM/PAIS é responsável, em parceria com a Secretaria Municipal de Saúde do Rio de Janeiro, pelo gerenciamento do Hospital Cardoso Fontes .

OHospital Cardoso Fontes, é direcionado ao atendimento de média e alta complexidade. É uma das principais referências hospitalares da Zona Oeste do Rio de Janeiro. A unidade é reconhecida por sua atuação na área de fisioterapia oncológica, ginecologia, nefrologia (sistema urinário) e tratamentos em crianças com insuficiência renal, pneumologia e urologia.

Responsável pelo atendimento especializado a crianças e adolescentes com distúrbios neurológicos, atuando no diagnóstico, tratamento e acompanhamento de condições que afetam o desenvolvimento do sistema nervoso central e periférico. Atua em conjunto com equipes multidisciplinares, contribuindo para a reabilitação e melhoria da qualidade de vida dos pacientes.

Principais Atividades:
  • Realizar consultas ambulatoriais e hospitalares com enfoque neurológico pediátrico.
  • Diagnosticar e tratar doenças como epilepsia, paralisia cerebral, autismo, TDAH, distúrbios do desenvolvimento, entre outras.
  • Solicitar e interpretar exames complementares (eletroencefalograma, neuroimagem, testes genéticos, etc.).
  • Prescrever medicamentos e tratamentos adequados de acordo com o diagnóstico.
  • Elaborar relatórios, laudos médicos e pareceres técnicos.
  • Acompanhar o desenvolvimento neurológico dos pacientes, realizando avaliações periódicas.
  • Trabalhar de forma integrada com psicólogos, fonoaudiólogos, terapeutas ocupacionais, fisioterapeutas e demais profissionais.
  • Orientar familiares sobre diagnósticos, tratamentos e prognósticos.
  • Participar de reuniões clínicas, discussões de caso e programas de educação continuada.

Graduação em Medicina com diploma reconhecido pelo MEC.

Residência médica em Pediatria.

Residência ou especialização em Neurologia Pediátrica.

Experiência de 6 meses na função.

Registro ativo no Conselho da Classe.

Local: Jacarepaguá/RJ

Escala: 20h semanais

Horário: a combinar

Descrição da vaga

Sobre a área:

A área é responsável pela gestão estratégica das redes sociais das marcas do Globoplay e de canais de variedades, entretenimento e esportivos do ecossistema Globo. Atua com as outras áreas de Marketing na conceituação e execução de planos de lançamento e sustentação dos projetos e campanhas alinhado aos objetivos de negócio de cada frente. Faz a gestão da relevância da presença das marcas nas plataformas com foco em engajamento com o consumidor, rentabilização e complementariedade de narrativas e públicos. Tem objetivo de criar estratégias que posicionem a Globo frente aos concorrentes dos territórios de Entretenimento, Esporte, Notícias e Streaming de forma inovadora, consistente e alinhado às mudanças de comportamento de consumo.

Diversidade:

Criamos ambientes onde todas as pessoas são incluídas, acolhidas e valorizadas. Nos empenhamos em ser uma Globo cada vez mais diversa, em representatividade e pensamento, aprendendo uns com os outros e estimulando a criatividade e inovação.

Modelo de trabalho:

Híbrido: Rio de Janeiro, RJ.

Responsabilidades e atribuições

Como será seu dia a dia:

  • Coordenar as frentes de Influência e Produção da área de Redes Sociais de Produtos Digitais;
  • Liderar as campanhas de marketing de influência do Globoplay e dos canais esportivos e não esportivos da Globo;
  • Atuar em parceria com outras lideranças na concepção, planejamento e gestão de projetos de lançamento e sustentação das marcas;
  • Gerenciar o time de Produção, responsável por toda a cadeia de execução: pré-produção, atuação in loco e pós-produção;
  • Garantir a entrega de conteúdos originais e coberturas de grandes eventos para os perfis do ecossistema;
  • Liderar a gestão orçamentária das campanhas de influência e dos projetos de produção.
Requisitos e qualificações

Do que você precisa:

  • Experiência em Marketing de Influência, com sólido conhecimento sobre a creator economy e o mercado de influenciadores, atuando estrategicamente na conexão entre marcas e creators;
  • Vivência em planejamento e acompanhamento de produções de conteúdo audiovisual, com domínio de todas as etapas do processo, desde concepção criativa até execução e entrega final;
  • Conhecimento emdesenvolvimento de storytelling, sendo capaz de transformar ideias, informações e dados em narrativas estratégicas, relevantes e criativas para diferentes plataformas;
  • Experiência na análise de métricas de redes sociais, utilizando dados e indicadores de performance para embasar tomadas de decisão estratégicas e otimização de resultados;
  • Vivência na criação e proposição de soluções criativas, alinhadas às linguagens, tendências e referências das redes sociais, garantindo relevância cultural e engajamento;
  • Perfil constantemente atento a novidades, insights e movimentos do mercado, contribuindo para o fortalecimento de um posicionamento de marca ousado, inovador e conectado às transformações digitais;
  • Experiência na elaboração de apresentações estratégicas em PowerPoint, com clareza narrativa, organização de informações e foco em objetivos de negócio;
  • Conhecimento e uso do Pacote Office, com destaque para Excel, aplicado à análise, organização e acompanhamento de dados e indicadores;
  • Vivência na gestão de orçamentos de campanhas e produções, assegurando controle financeiro, eficiência de custos e otimização de recursos;
  • Experiência em liderança e desenvolvimento de pessoas, com atuação direta na gestão, engajamento e evolução de equipes;
  • Atuação colaborativa, com perfil inquieto, curioso e antenado às constantes transformações do mercado, contribuindo ativamente em ambientes multidisciplinares;
  • Comunicação em inglês em nível avançado, com capacidade de conduzir interações profissionais, apresentações e análises no idioma.

Conhecimentos que te destacam:

  • Conhecimento e atuação prévia com agências de influenciadores do mercado.
Informações adicionais

Por que vir para Globo:

Vem e vamos criar histórias e tecnologias juntos. Na Globo, o encontro de histórias com tecnologia move um time diverso e apaixonado por inovação. A gente tem a chance de aproximar os brasileiros, criando novas formas de se conectar com eles. Aqui, cada um faz a transformação acontecer.

Os seus dados pessoais serão utilizados para fins de seleção de candidatos para preenchimento das vagas abertas na Globo. Os dados pessoais coletados durante o processo seletivo dos candidatos que não forem admitidos neste momento poderão ser mantidos nos bancos de dados para consideração em futuros processos seletivos. Todos os dados coletados serão tratados segundo rígidos padrões de segurança da informação e em total respeito às leis de privacidade aplicáveis, incluindo a Lei 13.709/18, e nos termos de nossa política de privacidade, disponível no link:
